display.purpose: The hero's name. One per viewport.

headline.purpose: Page and case-study titles, and section headings.

title.purpose: Project names and card headings, uppercase.

body.purpose: Running prose. Case studies read at 65-75ch.

small.purpose: Secondary prose: card taglines, button labels, nav links, link text.

label.purpose: The margin annotation: location line, availability line, section titles, year, status.

micro.purpose: Tag chips and the smallest metadata.

diagram.purpose: The ASCII architecture blocks only. The one monospace exception in the system, because a box-drawing diagram does not align in a proportional face.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: Reserved for elements that genuinely float over the sheet, such as the focused skip-to-content link. Never on cards, buttons or chips.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Colour and opacity transitions: nav links, braces, borders, buttons.

motion.name: duration-transform
motion.purpose: Transform transitions: the 2px lift on rail cards.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: The fade-in entrance: opacity and a 2px translate, ease-out, once per element.

motion.name: scramble-step
motion.purpose: Per-character step of the decode/scramble effect on nav labels and the locale switch.

grid.purpose: The drawing grid, painted on the body as a background-image beneath all content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's one primary action. The accent enters on hover; the button itself never moves.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(253, 255, 0, 0.3); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #fdff00; font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(253, 255, 0, 0.1); border-color: rgba(253, 255, 0, 0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fdff00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The repeated instance inside a case study: a hairline outline in muted ink that never competes with the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #fafafa; border-color: rgba(253, 255, 0, 0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fdff00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A nav label wrapped in accent braces that brighten and slide inward on hover, focus or current page.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; color: #a1a1a1; font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::before, .ds-nav-link::after { color: #fdff00; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.2; transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::before { content: '{'; transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: '}'; transform: translateX(-2px); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: #e5e5e5; } .ds-nav-link:hover::before, .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::before, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"]::before, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"]::after { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fdff00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Locale Switch
components.description: Swaps the locale of the current page and keeps the route: /es/proyectos/journal-api/ becomes /en/work/journal-api/.
components.css: .ds-locale-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; color: #a1a1a1; font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-locale-switch:hover, .ds-locale-switch:focus-visible { color: #e5e5e5; } .ds-locale-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fdff00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: A stack item or metadata tag. Muted, hairline-bordered, never accented except the project year.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
A technical document, printed on black paper, in which a single fluorescent ink marks what matters. The system is a sheet, not a dashboard: one surface (paper), one ink (base), one accent tint (accent), a hairline rule that behaves like a drafting guide, and margins that hold micro-labels in wide-tracked uppercase. Nothing competes for attention, because a technical sheet has one hierarchy — and the accent marks the one thing that matters at that moment.

The name is not decoration; it is already in the code. global.css labels its own base layer '/* Editorial baseline */'. The colour tokens are named for paper and ink: paper (#0a0a0a) is the sheet, base (#fafafa) is the ink, base.muted is the ink at the foot of the page, paper.subtle is the sheet under the sheet, and accent is the highlighter. The type scale is named h1 / h2 / body — document semantics, not terminal semantics. The 24px grid at 2% opacity is the drawing grid. There is no monospace in the system's prose, no glow, no scanline, no bloom: the uppercase-with-wide-tracking micro-labels are Work Sans set editorial, not a terminal, and boxShadow.subtle (0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03)) is the shadow of a lifted sheet, not an instrument light.

The decode/scramble effect is the system at its most characteristic: text emerging from noise, a metaphor for reading rather than for a machine. The fade-in on scroll is the document entering the reader's field.

Density is the discipline: one idea per block. If a block asks for two ideas, it is two blocks. The horizontal rail is the index of the file, its sheets ordered by weight; a work-experience entry is a sheet inside the document, not a project in the same tray, because real work does not compete with a portfolio piece.
keyCharacteristics: One accent ink, used as a highlighter: at most one accented element per viewport.
Flat surfaces separated by hairline rules, not shadows.
Micro-labels in uppercase with wide tracking as the margin annotation.
Generous real margins — 6rem block gaps, 2rem/4rem page padding, 62vh hero.
Motion is a single verb: the accent enters. Maximum 2px, and never on a button.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on at most one element per viewport. Its rarity is what makes it work.

rules.name: The Accent Lives Only on Paper Rule
rules.body: #fdff00 on paper measures 18.4:1 (AAA) and on paper.subtle 16.6:1 (AAA), but on base it is 1.03:1 — illegible. The accent therefore never appears as a background for text, and never appears over a light surface.

rules.name: The Accent Never Means Alone Rule
rules.body: The accent never encodes meaning by itself. Every accented mark is accompanied by text or by a shape.

rules.name: The Accent Never Grows Rule
rules.body: Accented text does not take a heavier weight or a larger size than the system already gives it. When accented text grows, it stops being a mark and becomes content.

rules.name: The Accent Has One Source Rule
rules.body: The accent is defined once, through the accent token, with the four named state opacities. Never a literal hex, never an invented rgba().

rules.name: The Uppercase Margin Rule
rules.body: Micro-labels are uppercase, tracked wide, 10–11px, and muted. They are never accented — with two exceptions, the year and the status tag.

rules.name: The No Second Voice Rule
rules.body: One family. The document does not gain a second typeface for emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only where something genuinely floats over the sheet. The separation between two surfaces is a hairline, not a shadow.

dos: Do keep the accent to one element per viewport. That rarity is the system's entire visual argument.
Do express the accent through the accent token with the four named state opacities (accent, accent/60, accent/30, accent/10), never as a literal hex or an invented rgba().
Do separate surfaces with a hairline border, and reserve shadow-subtle for something that genuinely floats.
Do move elements at most 2px, and only cards. Buttons do not move.
Do transition colour and opacity in 150ms and transforms in 200ms, and name the properties.
Do keep uppercase micro-labels at 10–11px, 0.1em tracking, muted — and accent only the year and the status tag.
Do use the rounded-subtle token (8px) everywhere a radius appears.
Do keep one idea per block; split the block rather than compressing two ideas into one.
Do put the accent only on paper and paper.subtle surfaces, never over base.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent tint, a gradient, or a light surface. The sheet is black and the ink is one colour.
Don't write transition: all — it animates layout properties and is how the incumbent ended up with four different hover durations.
Don't let a button move, lift or scale. The accent enters; the component stays.
Don't use the accent to encode meaning alone, and never to signal both state and content at once.
Don't grow accented text. A larger or heavier accent is content, not a mark.
Don't add a second focus-ring treatment. One ring, 2px solid accent, 2px offset, everywhere.
Don't use accent.dim (#d6d800). It is defined and has zero uses; it duplicates the accent without adding anything. Remove it.

Don't introduce a monospace face. The system has one family and the uppercase labels are not terminal output. The ASCII architecture diagrams are the single exception, and only because a box-drawing diagram does not align in a proportional face.
Don't raise or add motion to a component that does not already move.
